values.event_label: 'add delegation designation': delegation becomes persistent - authorization writes 0xef0100||address (using the EIP-3541 banned 0xef prefix) as the account's code; nonce becomes mandatory and authority nonce increments; code-retrieving operations (EXTCODE*, CALL family) follow the pointer; designator chains are not followed; EIP-3607 origination restriction modified to allow delegated EOAs; end-of-transaction code reset removed; revocation is now by re-delegation with the current nonce; title shortened to 'Set EOA account code'; requires gains 3541, 3607.
values.rationale: Fundamental redesign from transaction-scoped code setting to persistent delegation designators.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7702: add delegation designation

values.event_label: Fixes the delegation designator prefix in the Abstract from 0xef0000 to 0xef0100.

values.event_label: PR #8766 'various updates': adds PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST=25000 with a charge step for non-existent authorities; outer transaction fields now follow EIP-4844 semantics instead of EIP-1559 (null destination invalid); transactions with an empty authorization_list become invalid; cold-account resolution of delegated code costs an extra EIP-2929 COLD_ACCOUNT_READ 2600 gas.
values.rationale: Multiple normative validity and gas-accounting changes.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7702: various updates (#8766)

values.event_label: PR #8775: switches to charging the worst case upfront - intrinsic cost uses PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST per tuple with a PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST - PER_AUTH_BASE_COST refund when the authority exists; warm delegated-code resolution assessed at WARM_STORAGE_READ_COST 100.

values.source_title: Update EIP-7702: charge empty account upfront, refund diff during processing (#8775)

values.event_label: Switches order of authority warm access: authority is added to accessed_addresses before the code/nonce validity checks.

values.event_label: 'add a few clarifications': tuples are processed after the sender's nonce is incremented; the existing-authority refund goes to the global refund counter; EXTCODESIZE example corrected 24 -> 23; cold accounts touched during delegated-code resolution are added to accessed_addresses; propagation note that an EOA nonce can rise more than once per transaction.
